title: Pointwise formula for the support density
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number and let $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^{2m}$. The support density at $z$ equals the reciprocal of the uniform probability that a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^{2m}$ has inner product modulo two equal to $1$, multiplied by the indicator of that condition at $z$.
